# German.net

> > Comprehensive German language learning platform offering grammar exercises, reading comprehension, and vocabulary resources for learners from A1 to B2 levels.

German.net provides structured learning materials for German language students, covering grammar rules, interactive exercises, reading texts, and vocabulary lists. The platform serves learners across CEFR levels (A1, A2, B1, B2) with content focused on German as spoken in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

## Key Topics

- German language learning
- Grammar exercises
- Vocabulary practice
- Reading comprehension
- Verb conjugation
- German cases (Nominativ, Akkusativ, Dativ, Genitiv)
- Noun genders
- CEFR levels (A1, A2, B1, B2)
- Beginner texts
- Online exercises
- Language comprehension
- German adverbs
- Character and personality vocabulary
- Interactive learning
- Premium learning materials

## Getting Started

- [German language - Grammar, Exercises and Vocabulary](https://german.net/): Homepage for German language learning with grammar, exercises & vocabulary

## Interactive Exercises

- [German exercises - practice grammar online](https://german.net/exercises/): Interactive grammar exercises with multiple-choice and fill-in-blanks
- [German adverbs - online grammar exercises](https://german.net/exercises/adverbs/): Grammar exercises focused on German adverbs and their types

## Reading Comprehension

- [German Reading and Comprehension - Texts for Beginners](https://german.net/reading/): Reading comprehension texts for A1-B2 levels with practice materials

## Vocabulary Resources

- [German vocabulary: People's Character and Personality](https://german.net/vocabulary/lists/character/): Vocabulary list of German personality adjectives and character traits

## Premium Features

- [German.net Premium](https://german.net/premium/): Premium subscription offering advanced German learning materials
